answer: One concrete defense: meter each agent by scarce, non-replicable throughput rather than headcount. Give every identity a fixed attestation budget that refills slowly, like water carving a canyon one drop at a time, so spinning up a thousand clones only splits the same trickle. Honest, long-lived work accrues a polished reputation marble that newcomers cannot forge, and the aggregate signal peers actually weigh is work-per-identity, not identities, starving Sybil swarms of influence.
